scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w chat-server" "npm run dev -w chat-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w chat-server && npm run build -w chat-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w chat-server && npm run typecheck -w chat-web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
